name: publishing
description: Asks before something goes public or ships outside the organisation (a release, a package, a deploy, a post), whatever the request said. The same switch covers the shell commands that publish.

smartRules.name: shield:publishing:review-release
smartRules.reason: A release ships code to everyone who installs it. node9 asks before publishing, whatever the request said (Publishing shield).

smartRules.name: shield:publishing:review-package
smartRules.reason: This publishes a package. node9 asks before publishing (Publishing shield).
